core.fantasy: You are a gentleman scientist stranded in a strange gothic wilderness, keeping yourself fed, sane and alive one day at a time.
pillars: A world that turns on you as your mind slips
core.signature_moment: Sanity dropping, the screen wobbling and shadow hands reaching for the campfire.

signatures.description: Three need badges with direction arrows and a segmented day dial are the whole always-on HUD.
A meter doubled by the world: low sanity desaturates, wobbles and spawns shadows.
Everything, HUD included, is drawn in the same ink-and-paper style.

body.note: Three need badges with direction arrows; sanity bends the screen as it drops.

time.note: Segmented day dial with moon phase; dusk and night darken the world.

threat.note: Shadow creatures flicker, whispers start, total darkness attacks; hounds growl before a wave.

thing_state.note: Crops, fires and creatures show state in their art; examine quips above the head.

goals.note: No stated goal beyond surviving days.

tools.note: Inventory row and equipment slots at the bottom; crafting tabs on the left.

social.note: The character speaks one-line quips above their head; pigs and beefalo show mood by behaviour.

hud_coverage.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

always_on_count.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

screen_budget.fade_rule: Badges pulse and show numbers on change or hover; nothing fades.

signals.note: Desaturation and wobble, whispers, shadow creatures appear.
Dusk tint, night darkness, creatures go home, a dusk sting.

max_channels.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

adapts_score.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

social_channel.note: Spoken quips as floating text; creatures signal by behaviour.

dialects.note: No day dial underground; light and sound carry more.

style: need badges with a rate arrow
a meter doubled by the world
expression: the ink-and-paper look and badge art

take.setting: A round sun dial with day segments; night coming is shown by light, animals and sound together, at kid-safe strength.
